observed_value: fair_value_currency stored as U_GBP, U_EUR, and U_CAD on flagged rows
anchor_value: raw SOI fair value column is USD; non-USD marker belongs to Par/Shares

culprit_citations.quoted_text: Brush Group Bidco Limited | First Lien Secured Debt - Term Loan | SONIA + 500, 0.00% Floor | 07/30/31 | GBP | 5,970 | $ | 7,800 | $ | 7,941
Natus Sensory, Inc. continuation | First Lien Secured Debt - Term Loan | E + 525, 0.00% Floor | 01/07/31 | EUR | 95 | 98 | 106
Total Power Limited | First Lien Secured Debt - Term Loan | CORRA + 450, 0.75% Floor | 07/22/30 | C$ | 8,668 | 6,214 | 6,106

findings.detail: GBP par currency was assigned to fair_value_currency even though the source row's fair value is in the USD fair value column.
EUR par currency was assigned to fair_value_currency even though the source row places EUR in Par/Shares, not Fair Value.
CAD par currency was assigned to fair_value_currency even though the source row places C$ in Par/Shares, not Fair Value.

rationale: FX02 is a real data error. The flagged non-USD values are localized to fair_value_currency, but raw SOI rows show the non-USD currency marker in the Par/Shares area while the valuation columns are the filing's Cost and Fair Value columns. The extractor carried local principal currency into fair_value_currency rather than preserving USD valuation currency. Source was available and checked via evidence_cli.
